name: Rosemary Wells
notable_stories: Arthur Wells' biological daughter (~same age as George Sr., so ~1916), who became George Sr.'s step-sister and his closest sibling-figure — raised essentially as his sister
notes: Not a blood relative of Adams line. Step-sister of George Francis Adams Sr. Daughter of Arthur Wells.
CORRECTION 2026-09-22: Mother set to trumbo_serena_marie, wife of Arthur Wells (confirmed by Brendan Adams). This makes Rosemary a half sister, not a step-sister, of George Francis Adams Sr.
